title: Persistent first capture changes a two-arrival gate's dilute-feed scaling
statement: For 0->1 at lambda, 1->0 at mu, 1->2 at lambda and productive/waste 2->0 rates kp,kw, the stationary productive flux is kp lambda^2/[k(2lambda+mu)+lambda^2], k=kp+kw. Fixed mu>0 stays quadratic as lambda->0. Only the scale-separated regime mu<<lambda<<k gives approximately beta lambda/2 with beta=kp/k.

assumptions: first-order window requires mu/lambda small, not just finite cooperativity
no physical catalyst or coupled chemistry acquired
costs: reactant transport, regeneration, current, energy, separation and lifetime not free
contract.units: rates inverse time, flux products/site/time, selectivity dimensionless
contract.obstruction: Separates persistent kinetic storage from equilibrium pair enhancement and from claims of a measured manufacturing operation.

evidence.quote: A persistent first intermediate can turn a nominally two-particle, quadratic dilute-feed process into a first-order, supply-limited process.

review.scope: Exact source-supported extraction only; any scoped substantive acceptance is a separate version-bound review overlay.
